user.title: Set up BRUH Minecraft
user.description:
This integration talks to the BRUH Minecraft add-on running on this Home Assistant host. The add-on exposes sensors, buttons, and services for controlling your Minecraft server.

Server files live at `{server_dir}` and backups at `{backup_dir}`.

confirm.title: BRUH Minecraft discovered
confirm.description: Confirm setup to enable sensors, buttons, and services.

rcon_command.name: Run RCON command
rcon_command.description: Execute an arbitrary server command (no leading slash).

say.name: Broadcast chat
say.description: Send a chat message to all players.

give.name: Give item
give.description: Give an item to a specific player.

restart_server.name: Restart server
restart_server.description: Save worlds and restart the Minecraft server.

stop_server.name: Stop server
stop_server.description: Stop the Minecraft server (add-on stays running).

kick_player.name: Kick player
kick_player.description: Kick a player from the server.

ban_player.name: Ban player
ban_player.description: Ban a player from the server.

whitelist_add.name: Whitelist add
whitelist_add.description: Add a player to the whitelist.

whitelist_remove.name: Whitelist remove
whitelist_remove.description: Remove a player from the whitelist.

pardon_player.name: Unban player
pardon_player.description: Lift a ban on a player.

teleport.name: Teleport player
teleport.description: Move a player to another player, or to x/y/z coordinates.

player.name: Player
player.description: Who to move — a player name, or @a for everyone.

to_player.name: To player
to_player.description: The player to move them to. Leave empty to use x/y/z.

x.name: X
x.description: A number, or ~ / ~5 relative to where they are.

y.name: Y
y.description: A number, or ~ / ~5 relative to where they are.

z.name: Z
z.description: A number, or ~ / ~5 relative to where they are.

get_status.name: Get status
get_status.description: Who is online right now, beside the last collected server stats. Returns response data.

list_addons.name: List add-ons
list_addons.description: What the add-on browser can offer this server, and what is installed in the active world. Returns response data.

search_addons.name: Search add-ons
search_addons.description: Search Modrinth for server-side add-ons this server can run (every player gets them, Bedrock/iPad included). Returns response data.

install_addon.name: Install add-on
install_addon.description: Add a Modrinth project (and anything it requires) to the active world.

id.name: Project id
id.description: The Modrinth project id from search_addons.

remove_addon.name: Remove add-on
remove_addon.description: Take an add-on installed by the browser out of the active world.
